summary: All three flow-flagged candidates (CRWV, TSLA, QQQ) failed chair review: every dossier scored 2–3 (below the 6.0 threshold) and every skeptic either affirmed NO-TRADE or explicitly killed the idea, citing stale/underwater sweep flow, missing dark-pool and insider confirmation, dealer call-walls directly overhead, punitive front-week IV, and a confirmed mega-cap earnings wave (MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/INTC, 7–23.5% implied moves) landing inside the trade horizon. The final tide check corroborated the risk-off regime brief, with put premium accelerating ($211K → $422K by 08:10 ET) and net volume negative in every interval (worst -2,104). Zero specs issued for 2026-10-23 — capital stays flat ahead of the 10/26–10/27 earnings cluster; re-scan for confirmed, side-evidenced flow after the event wave clears.
